_comment: District 4 (GDD §4.1 chain order). Prereq verified in data/districts/district_school.tres: powered_by = [&"residential"] (NOT park). No district's tres lists school in powered_by, so school is currently a leaf of the power graph — flagged for CODE in docs/CONTENT_DISTRICT_SCHOOL.md, not a content-side fix. Threat tier 4 (shadow + crawler + watcher per scripts/enemies/enemy_pool.gd): teaches light discipline — watcher_3d.gd stuns for 2 s in the flashlight beam and then rages at 1.25x speed (school_note_03). Themed loot canon (district_loot.gd BY_DISTRICT): key/scrap/battery/paper. School has NO blueprint (district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS = residential/park/police/warehouses) — deliberately no blueprint fixed spawn here. Story doc canon: doc_school_incident (300 students in the shelter, the counting in the pipes). Repair-part guarantee mirrors district_loot.gd REPAIR_PARTS (2x cable/fuse/transistor). All item ids verified against data/items/*.tres (41 ids, 2026-09).

fixed_spawns.reason: Guarantee: cable for PARTIAL. Crew spool jammed in a bent locker, openable without a key (R1).
Guarantee: fuse for STREETS. Caretaker's spares beside the transformer pad; boiler room is unlocked from the cafeteria service door.
Guarantee: transistor for FULL. Shelter door is locked and opened by school_fix_key_01 — no lockpick required (R1).
Shelter key on the whistle lanyard in the equipment bin, exactly where grid crew log 7 (school_note_03) says it was put back.
Shelter-era first-aid cabinet by the duty desk; tier-4 district needs a guaranteed heal on entry.
Teaches the watcher lesson: distract down the corridor instead of lighting the thing that stares (school_note_03).
District themed material (district_loot.gd BY_DISTRICT school = key/scrap/battery/paper); crafting/journal stock.
Defense cache at the north exit toward the hospital road; STREETS stage only.
Battery top-up at the yard gate arriving from residential (flashlight is the only tool that works indoors).

rules: R1: In DARK, fixed_spawns alone must cover the repair chain (>=2 cable, >=2 fuse, >=2 transistor); the shelter key (school_fix_key_01) sits in an unlocked gym bin, so the transistors are reachable with zero lockpicks and zero rolled loot.
R2: Rolled loot never includes stage-gated items early: table lookup uses the CURRENT DistrictData.Stage only.
R3: Fixed spawns are one-time per save; rolls are per-container with container_modifiers on qty.
R4: No firearms in school (tier 4 stealth district; molotov/firework/noise_bomb remain the ceiling). Serum first appears in STREETS rolls.

R5: Light economy, not noise economy: this district's risk axis is line of sight. Long-sightline containers (corridor lockers, gym bins, lobby trophy case) are the rich ones; enclosed rooms (classroom desks, cafeteria pass) are safe and poor. A player who never opens a corridor container must still finish the chain via R1.
R6: Shelter caches (school_fix_puzzle_03, school_fix_key_01) must not roll empty — the basement is a scripted cache, not RNG.
R7: No blueprint spawns in school (district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS canon). If a future pass adds one, it belongs in z_boiler_room, not the shelter.
